_readme: Exceptions to tools/style-gate.cjs. ONLY the orchestrator edits this file, ONLY after a literal customer approval (diff is checked). Every entry MUST have ALL fields: selector, rule, reason, approvedBy ('customer'), approvedAt (YYYY-MM-DD), quote (verbatim customer words), source (questions/answers.json id, review/comments.json#id or chat date+id). An entry missing any field is IGNORED by the gate and reported as FAIL (E0). Optional: pages[], widths[], value (exempt only when the measured value equals it).

entries.reason: Hero Home background: the ONLY gradient on the site (vertical linear, --surface-accent-deep -> --surface-accent); design-system.md, Tokens.
